active.step: Speak to the Wise Old Man in the temple.
Speak to the Wise Old Man, in Bramblemead, to learn about the Farming skill.
Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village to learn about Fishing.

spells.how: Cast on one standing tree: turns it into a stack of bones (pairs with Bones to Peaches).
spells.name: Bark to Bones

spells.how: Cast on animal bones lying on the ground (up to 10): turns them into peaches.
spells.name: Bones to Peaches

spells.how: Cast on an enemy up to 40 m away: it attacks other monsters for 45 s. Hitting it yourself breaks the spell.
spells.name: Confuse

spells.how: Two parts: drop 5 ore (any kind) on the ground, then cast on them: they become a small personal ore node (15 ore when mined out).
spells.name: Divine Rock

spells.how: Cast on an opponent: weakens its attacks.
spells.name: Enfeeble

spells.how: Turns your view into a floating eye (up to 30 m away) to place/remove building pieces; leave it to get your view back.
spells.name: Eye Of Oculus

spells.how: A fire spirit follows you for 3 minutes and lights the way like a torch.
spells.name: Fire Spirit

spells.how: Cast on a fishing spot (node): each catch there gives one extra fish of the same kind while it lasts.
spells.name: Fishing Frenzy

spells.how: Refreshes your ACTIVE food and drink buffs (and their healing); does nothing if none are active.
spells.name: Internal Alchemy

spells.how: Two parts: drop the worn weapons/tools/armour on the floor, then cast on them: +50% durability each; they return to the nearest inventory.
spells.name: Magical Mending

spells.how: Cast on a mechanical processing station (tannery, loom, sawmill, grindstone, stonecutter): faster processing for a while.
spells.name: Overdrive

spells.how: Lets you air-dash again while airborne, up to 3 times per cast.
spells.name: Phase Dash

spells.how: Cast on growing plots or planted trees: advances them one growth stage; can't be reapplied until they grow again.
spells.name: Rapid Growth

spells.how: Starting Recall marks where I stand and opens a placement I can keep moving in; finishing it teleports me back to that mark. To come back to a spot, cast it with walk_to: I open it here, walk there while it is held, finish it, and I'm back here. Opened and finished on the spot it moves me 0 m, so cast needs walk_to. A finished Recall leaves no marker for a later cast. The game refuses it during its 75 s cooldown.
spells.name: Recall

spells.how: Two parts: drop the runes you want to convert on the ground first, then cast on them: gives back about 40% as rune essence.
spells.name: Runes To Rune Essence

spells.how: Lays a trap at your feet: enemies that walk to its centre are rooted for 8 s; a ranged/magic hit on the star triggers it.
spells.name: Snare

spells.how: Cast on fallen trees: chops them into logs (25 Woodcutting XP per quarter); never stumps.
spells.name: Splinter

spells.how: Summons wisps that lead to anima vents within 400 m (shown on the compass).
spells.name: Summon Elemental Spirits

spells.how: Needs flat ground: summons a tent with a bed anyone can rest in; damage dispels it.
spells.name: Summon Shelter

spells.how: Summons a spirit that leads to the nearest ore or clay within 200 m and waits there (up to 5 minutes).
spells.name: Summon Stone Spirits

spells.how: Cast on a fire-based processing station (campfire, grill, kiln, furnace...): +90% processing speed for 30 s.
spells.name: Superheat

spells.how: Gives 3 dodge charges for 2 minutes; each dodge carries you about 8 m.
spells.name: Surge

spells.how: An air shield: no damage while blocking for about a minute; if raised when it ends, it knocks nearby foes down.
spells.name: Tempest Shield

spells.how: Cast on fallen trees (several in a small area): turns them into one totem; follow with Splinter. Much less Woodcutting XP.
spells.name: Trunk Totem

spells.how: Harvests every fully grown crop and wild plant within 15 m and draws them to you.
spells.name: Uproot

spells.how: Reflects the damage of incoming attacks back at the attackers.
spells.name: Vengeance

spells.how: Jump much higher and fall slower; you have about 7 s to use it after casting.
spells.name: Windstep

spells.how: Needs an axe carried: throws an axe forward, felling trees in a line up to 30 m (limited by your best axe).
spells.name: Axtral Projection

spells.how: Cast on a fishing spot (node): pulls up to 5 fish out. You must carry a net or rod of that spot's power level or better.
spells.name: Fishnado

spells.how: Needs a claimed bed or bed roll: teleports you to it. 15 minute cooldown.
spells.name: Home Teleport

spells.how: Needs a watering can holding 50 units of water: waters the farming plots in a 3x5 area in front of you.
spells.name: Humidify

spells.how: Needs a fishing rod equipped: for 2 minutes fish caught with it come out cooked.
spells.name: Infernal Rod

spells.how: Needs 150 units of compost: cast on plots to fertilise up to about 4 of them.
spells.name: Mucksplosion

spells.how: Needs a pickaxe carried: breaks every boulder/ore node within 5 m of the target (limited by your best pickaxe).
spells.name: Rocksplosion

spells.how: Needs a two-handed bow equipped (not a crossbow): arrows pierce several targets; they can't be recovered.
spells.name: Spectral Arrows

note: vitals_rate nulled: the logged 41/54 per min was a fall across the 11:18:46 death (fixed in skills.lua: falls before the latest death/respawn are not drain), so the fixed body reports no rate 59 s after respawn.
